thread:
morgan: Quick sync  after the IA regroup some bookmarks break. Proposal: resolve legacy deep-links via an alias map, auto-expand the new side-group, and show a transient "Moved" ribbon with a clear action to open a migration helper. Thoughts?

tara: Love the ribbon idea. Its more visible than a tiny pill. Copy: "This link landed on a moved item: Workspaces > Models → Assets > Models. Open migration helper?" Dismissible, one-shot.

devin: Router flow: try exact match -> alias lookup -> render canonical node. If resolvedByAlias, show ribbon. Alias format: `[{pattern: "/workspaces/:wid/models/:mid", canonical: "/assets/models/:mid"}]` (versioned). Keep browser URL unchanged by default.

alex: UX: expand group, smooth-scroll + focus to item, update breadcrumb to the canonical path, and highlight briefly. Ribbon should include an explicit "Open helper" button and a small "Moved from Workspaces" label near the breadcrumb.

sam: A11y: when ribbon appears, announce via aria-live polite: "Opened: MyModel — moved to Assets > Models." Make ribbon button keyboard focusable and the helper drawer must trap focus. Ensure contrast >=4.5:1 for ribbon text.

lina: Instrument: alias hit rate, ribbon shown/clicked, helper opened, 404 spikes for 2 weeks.

deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy: 2024-12-10 03:00 UTC :rocket:

morgan: OK I'll write the spec: alias JSON shape, ribbon visual + copy, focus behavior, and a11y acceptance criteria. Will open PR and tag owners.
